purpose: Verify creation of a basic user with a unique Institute ID is permitted.
preconditions: Institute ID 'BR_USER_001' does not exist in Fusion.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits user creation with institute_id='BR_USER_001', email='br_user_001@iiitdmj.ac.in', user_type='student'.
expected_result: Account created successfully with unique Institute ID.

purpose: Verify creation of a user with a duplicate Institute ID is prohibited.
preconditions: A user with institute_id='BR_USER_DUP' already exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to create another user with institute_id='BR_USER_DUP'.
expected_result: Operation is rejected with duplicate ID error.

purpose: Verify Institute ID immutability prohibits modification after user creation.
preconditions: A user with institute_id='BR_IMMUTABLE_01' exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to update the user's institute_id to 'BR_IMMUTABLE_MOD'.
expected_result: Modification rejected or original Institute ID remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify user creation with a valid institute domain email is permitted.
preconditions: Email 'br_valid@iiitdmj.ac.in' is not yet registered.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits user creation with institute_email='br_valid@iiitdmj.ac.in'.
expected_result: Email validated and user account created successfully.

purpose: Verify user creation with a non-institute domain email is prohibited.
preconditions: Institute email validation policy active for @iiitdmj.ac.in.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits user creation with institute_email='invalid_user@gmail.com'.
expected_result: Operation rejected due to invalid non-institute email domain.

purpose: Verify student creation with complete required programme and batch data is permitted.
preconditions: Valid student parameters provided.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits student creation with programme='B.Tech', batch_year=2026, department='CSE'.
expected_result: Student account created successfully with required academic data.

purpose: Verify student creation missing required programme or batch is prohibited.
preconditions: Student profile data missing batch_year or programme.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits student creation with programme='' or batch_year=None.
expected_result: Creation rejected with missing required fields error.

purpose: Verify faculty/staff creation missing required employee ID or department is prohibited.
preconditions: Faculty profile data missing employee_id or department.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits faculty creation with user_type='faculty' but employee_id=''.
expected_result: Creation rejected with missing employee ID error.

purpose: Verify archival of deactivated user past minimum deactivation interval is permitted.
preconditions: User is deactivated and deactivation interval has elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin initiates archival for the eligible deactivated user.
expected_result: Archival succeeds, user status becomes archived.

purpose: Verify archival of an active user is prohibited.
preconditions: User has status='active'.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to archive the active user.
expected_result: Archival rejected because user is not deactivated.

purpose: Verify archival of deactivated user before minimum interval has elapsed is prohibited.
preconditions: User deactivated recently (less than configured minimum interval days).
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts archival without bypass flag.
expected_result: Archival rejected due to unelapsed minimum interval.

purpose: Verify restoration of archived user within reversible window with authorization is permitted.
preconditions: Archived user record is in 'reversible' status within deadline.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits restore with valid authorization reference.
expected_result: User restored to active status with dashboard access restored.

purpose: Verify restoration of archived user without authorization reference is prohibited.
preconditions: Archived user record in 'reversible' status.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits restore request with empty authorization reference.
expected_result: Restoration rejected due to missing authorization reference.

purpose: Verify restoration of archived user after reversibility deadline is prohibited (permanent).
preconditions: Archived user whose reversibility deadline has passed.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to restore expired archived user.
expected_result: Restoration rejected; record marked permanent_non_restorable.

purpose: Verify a user can hold multiple compatible additional roles simultaneously.
preconditions: User already holds an active non-singular role.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns a second non-singular, non-conflicting role to the same user.
expected_result: Second role assigned successfully; user has two concurrent active roles.

purpose: Verify singular role assignment is permitted when the role is vacant in that scope.
preconditions: Singular role (e.g. Dean R&C) has no active holder.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns the singular role to an eligible faculty member.
expected_result: Assignment succeeds; role becomes occupied.

purpose: Verify singular role assignment is prohibited when already occupied by another user in same scope.
preconditions: Singular role is currently actively held by User A in scope 'Institute'.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to assign the same singular role to User B in scope 'Institute'.
expected_result: Assignment rejected due to singular role occupancy conflict.

purpose: Verify role assignment with valid start date and future end date is permitted.
preconditions: Role parameters have start_date <= end_date.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns role with start_date=today, end_date=today+180 days.
expected_result: Assignment created successfully.

purpose: Verify role assignment with end date earlier than start date is prohibited.
preconditions: Role parameters have end_date < start_date.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits assignment with start_date=2026-06-01, end_date=2026-05-01.
expected_result: Assignment rejected with invalid date range error.

purpose: Verify scheduled role assignment automatically activates when start date is reached.
preconditions: Assignment created in 'scheduled' status with start_date <= today.
action_or_input: System runs activation check (RoleService.activate_scheduled_roles).
expected_result: Assignment status transitions from 'scheduled' to 'active'.

purpose: Verify active role automatically expires when configured end date has passed.
preconditions: Assignment has end_date in the past and status='active'.
action_or_input: System runs expiry check (RoleService.expire_ended_roles).
expected_result: Assignment status transitions to 'expired'.

purpose: Verify role assignment to an allowed user type is permitted.
preconditions: Role allowed_user_types includes 'faculty'; user is faculty.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns the role to the faculty member.
expected_result: Role assigned successfully without eligibility error.

purpose: Verify role assignment to a prohibited user type is rejected.
preconditions: Role allowed_user_types is ['faculty']; user is 'student'.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to assign the faculty role to the student.
expected_result: Assignment rejected due to user-type eligibility policy.

purpose: Verify assignment of mutually compatible non-conflicting roles is permitted.
preconditions: No conflict rule exists between Role A and Role B.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns Role B to a user already holding Role A.
expected_result: Assignment succeeds.

purpose: Verify assignment of mutually conflicting roles is prohibited.
preconditions: RoleConflict configured between Role X and Role Y.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to assign Role Y to a user actively holding Role X.
expected_result: Assignment rejected due to separation-of-duties role conflict.

purpose: Verify active role reassignment transfers tasks and updates previous and new holder statuses.
preconditions: Role is actively held by User A; User B is eligible.
action_or_input: Super Admin reassigns role to User B with disposition='transfer'.
expected_result: New assignment created for User B; User A assignment marked reassigned.

purpose: Verify reassigning an inactive or expired role assignment is prohibited.
preconditions: Assignment has status='revoked' or 'expired'.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to reassign the revoked assignment.
expected_result: Reassignment rejected because assignment is not active.

purpose: Verify previous holder retains read-only audit access during configured audit window.
preconditions: Assignment was reassigned; audit_until date is in the future.
action_or_input: System queries previous holder audit access window.
expected_result: Audit access period is active until configured deadline.

purpose: Verify previous holder audit access is terminated once configured audit period elapses.
preconditions: Assignment previous_holder_audit_until date is in the past.
action_or_input: System evaluates audit access eligibility for past holder.
expected_result: Audit access is expired and no longer granted.

purpose: Verify standard role revocation with at least one day notice is permitted.
preconditions: Role assignment is active.
action_or_input: Super Admin schedules revocation with effective_date = today + 2 days and reason.
expected_result: Revocation accepted and recorded with effective date.

purpose: Verify emergency role revocation takes immediate effect without advance notice.
preconditions: Role assignment is active.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits revocation with is_emergency=True, effective_date=today.
expected_result: Revocation takes immediate effect; assignment status set to revoked.

purpose: Verify standard revocation with insufficient notice (< 1 day) is prohibited.
preconditions: Role assignment is active; is_emergency=False.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits standard revocation with effective_date <= today.
expected_result: Revocation rejected due to insufficient notice period.

purpose: Verify deactivation of a basic user automatically revokes all associated active roles.
preconditions: User holds one or more active role assignments.
action_or_input: Super Admin deactivates the user account.
expected_result: User status becomes deactivated and all active role assignments are revoked.

purpose: Verify expiry reminders are sent when role expiry approaches within configured lead time.
preconditions: Active role assignment has end_date within reminder threshold (e.g. 15 days).
action_or_input: System executes send_expiry_reminders.
expected_result: Notification created and sent to role holder.

purpose: Verify role validity extension with valid approval reference and future end date is permitted.
preconditions: Assignment is active and nearing expiry.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits extension with new_end_date > current_end_date and approval_ref.
expected_result: Role end date extended and history recorded.

purpose: Verify role extension without approval reference or with non-future date is prohibited.
preconditions: Assignment is active.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits extension with empty approval_ref or new_end_date <= current_end_date.
expected_result: Extension rejected with validation error.

purpose: Verify archival of historical operational data satisfying retention-age criterion is permitted.
preconditions: Data category exists and date range represents completed academic/operational periods.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives historical data with valid date range and backup ref.
expected_result: ArchivedHistoricalData record created in 'archived' status.

purpose: Verify historical data archival with invalid reversed date range is prohibited.
preconditions: Start date is after end date.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits archival with date_range_end < date_range_start.
expected_result: Archival rejected due to invalid date range.

purpose: Verify a verified backup reference is created and associated prior to archival.
preconditions: Historical data archival request submitted.
action_or_input: Archival process completes successfully.
expected_result: Archived data record has non-empty backup_reference and backup metadata.

purpose: Verify retention expiry date is calculated and enforced based on retention policy years.
preconditions: Archival request specifies retention_years=5.
action_or_input: System creates ArchivedHistoricalData record.
expected_result: retention_expiry_date is set to date_range_end + 5 years.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can perform read-only searches and queries on archived records.
preconditions: Archived records exist in the system.
action_or_input: Super Admin executes search/filter on archival records endpoint.
expected_result: Matching archived records returned in read-only format.

purpose: Verify direct write modification on archived user records is prohibited.
preconditions: Archived user record exists.
action_or_input: System verifies archived records cannot be directly edited via standard user edit APIs.
expected_result: User edit API rejects updating archived basic users.

purpose: Verify permanent purge request is permitted after retention period has expired.
preconditions: Archived record retention_expiry_date has passed.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits purge request with regulatory authorization ref.
expected_result: Purge request created in 'pending_authorization' status.

purpose: Verify permanent purge request is prohibited before retention period has elapsed.
preconditions: Archived record retention_expiry_date is in the future.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to request permanent purge.
expected_result: Purge request rejected because retention period has not expired.

purpose: Verify permanent purge execution is permitted upon valid administrative authorization.
preconditions: Purge request is pending authorization.
action_or_input: Authorized administrator submits approval decision with comments.
expected_result: Purge request authorized and marked approved/completed.

purpose: Verify permanent purge execution without authorization is prohibited.
preconditions: Purge request has status='rejected' or is unauthorized.
action_or_input: System attempts to execute purge on unauthorized request.
expected_result: Execution rejected; target record is not deleted.

purpose: Verify role assignment or revocation dispatches notification within specified timing policy.
preconditions: Role assignment or revocation operation executed.
action_or_input: System processes role lifecycle event.
expected_result: Notification record created immediately in AdminNotification store.

purpose: Verify failed login attempts are logged in SessionLog.
preconditions: User submits incorrect password.
action_or_input: SecurityService logs failed authentication event.
expected_result: SessionLog entry created with is_successful=False.

purpose: Verify five consecutive failed login attempts trigger high-severity security alert.
preconditions: 4 failed login attempts already recorded for user.
action_or_input: 5th consecutive failed login attempt is recorded.
expected_result: SecurityAlert generated with alert_type='BRUTE_FORCE' / high severity.

purpose: Verify all Super Admin administrative actions generate permanent audit records.
preconditions: Super Admin executes an auditable action.
action_or_input: AuditService.log_action is executed.
expected_result: SystemAdminAuditLog record persisted with action, actor, timestamp.

purpose: Verify audit log records cannot be modified or deleted via administrative APIs.
preconditions: Audit log records exist.
action_or_input: System checks that no update/delete endpoint is exposed for audit logs.
expected_result: Audit logs remain immutable and permanently retained.

purpose: Verify Super Admin accesses administrative metadata without exposing isolated module payloads.
preconditions: Super Admin queries administrative views.
action_or_input: Super Admin fetches user profiles, role definitions, and system metrics.
expected_result: Administrative metadata returned correctly without unauthorized cross-module data.

purpose: Verify Super Admin role does not automatically grant unrestricted access to departmental academic data.
preconditions: System Admin module permissions configured.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to query unauthorized operational endpoints without module role.
expected_result: Access governed strictly by explicit permissions in session.

purpose: Verify valid Super Admin session creation and termination upon logout.
preconditions: Super Admin credentials valid.
action_or_input: Session started, then terminated via logout.
expected_result: SessionLog updated with logout_time and status.

purpose: Verify concurrent session control policy terminates or rejects conflicting active sessions.
preconditions: Active session already exists for Super Admin.
action_or_input: SecurityService checks single active session policy.
expected_result: Single active session constraint enforced or prior session invalidated.

purpose: Verify Super Admin attempting to revoke or modify own Super Admin status is prohibited.
preconditions: Super Admin is logged in as 'superadmin'.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to revoke or de-escalate own Super Admin role assignment.
expected_result: Self-modification rejected with prohibited action error.

purpose: Verify critical operation executes successfully when valid reauthentication token is provided.
preconditions: Critical operation requires confirmation token; valid token provided.
action_or_input: Super Admin invokes critical operation with valid confirmation_token.
expected_result: Reauthentication verified; critical operation proceeds.

purpose: Verify critical operation is rejected when reauthentication token is invalid or missing.
preconditions: Critical operation requires confirmation token.
action_or_input: Super Admin invokes critical operation with invalid confirmation_token='bad_token'.
expected_result: Operation rejected due to reauthentication failure.

purpose: Verify bulk user operation within maximum threshold (<= 1000 records) is permitted.
preconditions: List of 5 user records submitted for bulk creation.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits bulk user creation with count <= 1000.
expected_result: Bulk creation accepted and processed.

purpose: Verify bulk operation exceeding maximum threshold (> 1000 records) is prohibited.
preconditions: Bulk payload containing 1001 user records.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits bulk operation exceeding 1000 limit.
expected_result: Bulk operation rejected with limit exceeded error.

purpose: Verify password within configured rotation period permits normal authentication.
preconditions: Super Admin password set 10 days ago (rotation interval is 90 days).
action_or_input: System evaluates password age.
expected_result: Password recognized as valid and not expired.

purpose: Verify password exceeding rotation period requires password change.
preconditions: Super Admin password age exceeds configured max_rotation_days.
action_or_input: System checks password expiration policy.
expected_result: Password flagged as expired; rotation required.

purpose: Verify in-system and email notifications are dispatched for supported administrative events.
preconditions: User lifecycle or role event triggered.
action_or_input: NotificationService.send_notification called with channel='in_system'.
expected_result: Notification saved with correct channel and recipient.

purpose: Verify audit log entries capture mandatory schema fields (timestamp, actor, action, result).
preconditions: Administrative operation performed.
action_or_input: System queries logged audit record.
expected_result: Audit log entry contains non-empty timestamp, actor_username, action, and result.

purpose: Verify selecting an active assigned role enforces associated module permissions.
preconditions: User holds active role with 'systemadmin.user.view' permission.
action_or_input: User accesses user view endpoint with active role session.
expected_result: Access granted with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify selecting an inactive or revoked role denies module access.
preconditions: User role is in 'revoked' or 'expired' status without valid active permissions.
action_or_input: User attempts to perform administrative action.
expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify updating permitted administrative configuration keys is allowed.
preconditions: Key is in permitted set (e.g. session_timeout_minutes, archival_reversible_window_days).
action_or_input: Super Admin updates 'session_timeout_minutes' with valid value within policy bounds.
expected_result: Configuration updated successfully and logged.

purpose: Verify attempting to modify disallowed operational or academic configuration is prohibited.
preconditions: Configuration key is outside permitted administrative boundary (e.g. academic_grading_scale).
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to set an unauthorized configuration parameter.
expected_result: Update rejected as outside permitted configuration boundary.
